purpose: EIGHT-ROW SMOKE for SAEA-SLURP-DEV1000-CLOSED-LIST-LOGPROB-REPLICATE-V1. Same baseline fragment, same model fragment, same dataset fragment, same arm, same packets, same instruction -- eight samples instead of one thousand. EIGHT, not four, and the number is the reason: the serving geometry is -np 8 and the model fragment's id_slot policy is per-sample, so eight rows touch every slot of the resident server exactly once. It re-proves, on this pass and not on a four-month-old one, the precondition the predecessor's own smoke established: that the pinned llama-server returns a choices[0].logprobs object on the SPEECH-FEATURE PACKET route with five alternatives per generated token, and that a MODEL_LOGPROBS record lands with a recomputable logprobs_sha256. Its own exposure row, its own run id, its own attempt accounting; its numbers are a wiring proof and are never reported as a result and never read by the frozen judge.

populations.basis: The first EIGHT DEV-1000 sample ids in sorted order -- the predecessor smoke's own four (configs/experiment/slurp-dev1000-closed-list-logprob-smoke-4-v1.json) followed by the next four in the same order. Named HERE in the registered fragment so a smoke can never quietly fly eight different rows than the ones its exposure row names.

acceptance: The smoke passes when all eight rows return a choices[0].logprobs object, every generated token carries a top_logprobs list of exactly five entries whose first entry is the sampled token, eight MODEL_LOGPROBS records land in the trace with recomputable logprobs_sha256 and requested_top_logprobs 5, and each row's answer reconstructed from its own token stream is a prefix of its sealed text -- the one alignment the frozen judge depends on. It fails, and the 1,000-row cell does not fly, if any row returns no object, if the alternatives are truncated below five on a token whose vocabulary could supply them, or if any reconstruction is not a prefix.
budget_basis: 8 contacts plus margin for one permitted recovery within the same run id = 12 planned model calls. The eight rows' own audio is under 30 seconds; 60 is the rounded ceiling. GPU hours 0.05 covers eight contacts against a resident server; this family attaches to serving and never starts or stops it. Paid API spend 0. Plan cells are RUN-CUMULATIVE across every attempt of this run id.
